description: 08:15 - 10:00: Cement plug in annulus between 13 3/8in CSG and 20in CSG. Theoretical height from 850m to 450m Pumped 20 m3 of wash pill, 1200 l/min/ 13 bar. Mixed and pumped 35 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with cement unit with 11 m3 of drill water, 1200 l/min, pumping pressure went up to 50 bar.
